title: The persisted clock record of the supervisor or the host watchdog: high-water mark of true time, boot id, counter and latched cap decisions (allocator.md, L7 and B2)
x-owner: P12.3 (supervisor, role supervisor) and P10.7 (watchdog, role watchdog) write it; the providers read the watchdog's record for the start gate; consumers P02.1
description: Atomic record after each tick/run and after bounded enforcement attempts, never a prerequisite I/O before power-off. high_water_utc is nondecreasing and at least written_utc; decided_utc uses that high-water domain, floored at known reservation starts after clock loss. trigger deadline requires known elapsed_s at least cap_hours hours; host_reboot and clock_unavailable allow a nonnegative measured age or null, never fabricated elapsed time. enforcement_stage persists power_off_attempted, worker_stop_attempted, off or cap_breach; the next run resumes that stage instead of repeating E1 indefinitely. Only observed Off marks off; a cap_breach retains capacity, blocks starts and remains unresolved until verified recovery. mono_ms is boot-bound; boot_id changes each host boot.
